visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair styled in low pigtails and wearing a black beret walks toward the camera in a narrow urban alleyway. She is dressed in an oversized black t-shirt featuring a colorful graphic of a cat, layered over a black and white plaid shirt that extends below the hem. She wears loose black trousers and black platform shoes. The background consists of a tall stone wall covered in large, faded graffiti tags under bright, natural daylight. She smiles brightly and glances at the camera while swinging her arms rhythmically as she walks. (2) The scene cuts to the woman walking along a modern city sidewalk under the shade of green trees. She has changed into a white t-shirt with a small black cat emblem on the chest and a long, flowing black skirt. She carries a black leather shoulder bag with a thin strap. She continues to smile and look directly at the viewer. The background features a brick building with large glass windows and parked motorcycles. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her expressive facial features and the texture of her clothing. (3) The woman is back in her black graphic t-shirt outfit, walking past the wooden storefront of a restaurant with a yellow promotional poster visible in the window. She walks with a playful gait, occasionally looking away and then back at the camera. The background shows a mix of traditional wooden architecture and modern urban elements. The camera tracks her movement closely, maintaining a medium shot that captures her torso and head. Her expression remains joyful and energetic throughout the sequence. (4) The setting transitions to a sunlit park with a curved paved walkway. The woman, wearing the black t-shirt outfit again, walks away from the camera and then turns her head to smile back over her shoulder. Large trees with thick trunks and lush green leaves line the path, casting soft shadows on the ground. A warning sign is visible in the background near the foliage. The camera follows her at an eye-level angle, emphasizing the casual and breezy atmosphere of the outdoor environment. (5) A close-up shot shows the woman in her white t-shirt and beret, standing outdoors near a textured white wall and large green succulent plants. She smiles warmly and reaches up to adjust the brim of her black beret with her right hand. Her makeup is natural, and her eyes sparkle with amusement. The bright daylight creates a high-contrast look, accentuating the details of her pigtails and the clean lines of her outfit. The camera is static in this final moment, focusing on her face and shoulder area.
